selectionHint: Select a source record to inspect its point and Street View, or return to the trip endpoints.
chronological: Ordered by established UTC instant. Equal instants keep their returned order. Source time text remains unchanged.
sourceOrder: Input source order is preserved. UTC alignment and time intervals have not been established for every record.
recordPolicy: Rows retain their source and record ID. Repeated coordinates at different records or times remain separate. Duplicate source records are handled when the dataset is loaded.
unavailableHint: A usable point selection is not available. Recorded trip endpoints remain independent of point retrieval.
emptyHint: The completed selection returned no point records. This does not establish that no movement occurred.
missingSelection: The selected record is not in the loaded point selection. Choose an available row or return to the trip endpoints.
thresholdAfter: minutes between valid positions with established UTC instants.
intervalHint: This chosen viewing rule describes the loaded records. It does not establish a device sampling frequency, a missing physical journey or continuous coverage.
intervalsUnassessed: Intervals are not assessed: at least two valid positions and established UTC instants for every loaded record are required.
noLongIntervals: No interval above this threshold was found between the loaded valid positions.
declaredHint: These intervals belong to the supplied source coverage. They are separate from Holita's interval rule and are not recalculated from this list.
noDeclaredGaps: No gaps are declared in this source coverage. That does not establish continuous coverage.
